subject: Accelerator co-fund usage covenant and SLA exemption request
messages:
From: Natalie Wu <natalie@launchpad.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Conor Hayes <conor@syndicate.vc>, accounts@launchpad.ai
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood credits for LaunchPad summer cohort (allocation + activation timeline)

Irene — thanks again for the intro and for offering LaunchPad a co-funded credit pool for our summer cohort. Finance would like a short schedule + clear runbook we can share with our cohort managers so credits are activated and revoked cleanly.

Quick asks from our side:
- Final allocation per startup (we discussed $2,500 equivalent in runway credits, but need an exact token/usage mapping).
- Activation window (start/end dates) and any automatic expiry or manual reclamation steps.
- Any SLA exemptions or throttling rules we should tell founders about (esp. long-running evals).

Attached are the cohort dates. Can you confirm the activation and whether Redwood can accept a shared usage dashboard for auditing? We also need an MOU to sign between LaunchPad and Redwood’s partner ops to document the fund.

Best,
Natalie
Director, Partnerships — LaunchPad Accelerator
[attachment: cohort-schedule-summer-2026.pdf]
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Wu <natalie@launchpad.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for LaunchPad summer cohort (allocation + activation timeline)

Hi Natalie — great to connect. High level answers below; will follow up with an ops runbook and an MOU draft by end of day tomorrow.

1) Allocation mapping: our platform measures consumption in token-equivalent units; for this cohort we’ll convert $2,500 (list price) to a 500k token allotment per startup (approx.). We'll publish a short conversion table for founders.

2) Activation window: we can schedule activation to match cohort kickoff (2026-06-15). Default expiry is 90 days after activation, but we can set a manual reclamation policy at the cohort end date if you prefer.

3) SLA exemptions: we don’t usually exempt SLAs, but we can configure a soft-throttle policy for long-running evals to protect latency SLOs for paying customers. We can document expected QPS and token-per-minute ceilings in the runbook.

Action items for us: Ben will pull the activation runbook + CSV of allocations; Vanessa will prepare an MOU draft for partner signature; Tessa will add a monitoring dashboard share and HubSpot deal updates.

Irene
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for LaunchPad summer cohort (allocation + activation timeline)

Folks — attaching a first-pass activation runbook and the CSV export with per-startup allocations that map to the $2,500 equivalent. Notes:
- activation-runbook.xlsx: step-by-step (env tags, entitlement keys, role-based claims, revocation commands).
- credit-allocation-summary.csv: columns = startup_name, founder_email, entitlement_id, token_budget, activation_date, expiry_date.

Operational constraints to call out (recommend sharing with LaunchPad):
- We will mark all cohort entitlements with a partner tag (launchpad:summer-2026) and set a default 90-day TTL. Manual reclamation requires a support ticket by the partner ops contact.
- For long-running batch evals, if token rate exceeds configured ceilings we will place the job on a best-effort queue; this can increase completion time. If LaunchPad needs guaranteed throughput, we should offer a paid burst bucket.

Attaching files: activation-runbook.xlsx, credit-allocation-summary.csv, and a short sample entitlement JSON for reference.

Best,
Ben
Partner Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[attachment: activation-runbook.xlsx]
[attachment: credit-allocation-summary.csv]
From: Natalie Wu <natalie@launchpad.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Conor Hayes <conor@syndicate.vc>, accounts@launchpad.ai
Date: 2026-05-31T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for LaunchPad summer cohort (allocation + activation timeline)

Thanks — this is helpful. Couple of clarifying Qs from our finance/legal folks:
1) Can Redwood accept a one-line MOU that states Redwood will hold allocated entitlements in escrow and will not bill startups directly for consumption under the LaunchPad tag? Our legal wants the ability to reclaim unused credits after cohort close.
2) Is there a way for LaunchPad to get read-only access to per-startup usage (email or dashboard) for auditing?

Also Conor asked whether we can stagger activations (some startups kick off earlier), so we might need per-startup activation dates reflected in the CSV rather than a single cohort-wide date.

If you can send the MOU + a DocuSign link we can route internally.

—Natalie
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Wu <natalie@launchpad.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, accounts@launchpad.ai
Date: 2026-06-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for LaunchPad summer cohort (allocation + activation timeline)

Natalie — thanks for the questions. Summary and next steps below.

On escrow & billing:
- We can accept the one-line MOU language you proposed. Redwood will hold entitlements under the partner tag (launchpad:summer-2026) and will not bill startups directly for usage tied to an active entitlement. Unused credits will be reclaimable by LaunchPad at cohort close per the MOU. We’ll put this in the MOU draft.

On read-only access:
- Tessa will share a read-only dashboard link (per-startup filters) with LaunchPad ops. Additionally we can push weekly CSV usage exports to accounts@launchpad.ai.

On staggered activations:
- Ben updated the CSV so activation_date is per row. We will run a pre-activation validation 48 hours before each startup’s requested start date.

Attachments sent for signature: MOU draft (mou-draft.pdf) and the runbook + allocation CSV. Please review and, if acceptable, sign via the DocuSign link below.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rsrc/LAUNCHPAD-MOU-1183
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/record/DEAL-1183

If LaunchPad needs the SLA exemption language (to note the soft-throttle behavior in case of heavy batch loads), see section 3.2 of the runbook. If you want an explicit paid-burst / guarantee, we can draft an addendum.

Next steps (timeline):
- 24–48h: LaunchPad reviews MOU + returns signed DocuSign.
- 72h before cohort start: first batch of activations validated and pushed.
- Weekly: usage CSV pushed to accounts@launchpad.ai and dashboard live.

I’ll mark the HubSpot deal as partner-approved once the MOU is signed.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
[attachment: mou-draft.pdf]
